premises.text: Agricultural output must rise ~60% while climate-related crop failures increase
premises.evidence_span: we're going to need to increase our agricultural output by 60%. That's 60% more food, more clothes, and more medicine. And at the same time, we're expecting a massive uptick in the number of climate-related crop failures

premises.text: GWAS and traditional breeding are slow, costly, and low-precision bottlenecks for complex traits
premises.evidence_span: The genome-wide association studies are our current state-of-the-art, but only about 14% of the things that they return are actually useful, and sometimes it's as low as 1%. And after you're done finding your target genes, it's at least five years and up to $100 million to produce even a simple genetically modified variety. Or you could run a traditional plant breeding program, which could take a decade or more

premises.text: Interpretable ML on natural-selection history identifies causal gene targets at ~90% precision
premises.evidence_span: a new discovery method that, instead of the 14% accuracy of GWAS, allows us to identify causal gene targets with 90% precision

premises.text: An AI recommendation system suggests plant crosses using ~1/100th the usual data and forecasts outcomes before breeding
premises.evidence_span: an AI-enabled recommendation system that suggests which plant crosses might produce the traits that we're looking for. And it does that with only a hundredth of the data that's normally required

premises.text: Higher discovery accuracy shortens discovery and development by up to 77%
premises.evidence_span: lets us increase the process of discovery and development by up to 77%

premises.text: Cost/time efficiency makes any crop economically feasible and supports partner breeding pipelines
premises.evidence_span: we can actually work on any crop in the world. So even crops that were too complicated or too costly to work on are now economically feasible for us. And as a result, we're working with a number of pilot partners to get our technology into their existing breeding pipelines

premises.text: The company also creates new seeds with partners (e.g., alternative rubber, sunflowers, drought-resistant cotton)
premises.evidence_span: the real goal of our company is to make new seeds, and we're currently doing that with partners like Farmed Materials to create an alternative source of rubber, and with our own R&D pipeline to create sustainable sunflowers for cooking oil and drought-resistant cotton with better fiber quality
